skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the legal framework for international commercial arbitration, including domestic and international legal texts, basic characteristics of arbitration procedures, relationship between national and international laws related to arbitration agreements, procedures, and awards.
Apply knowledge through reading real cases, textbooks, and other research materials related to international arbitration.
Develop critical thinking skills, have personal opinions, and develop ideas to support the formation of personal views.
Write clear, logical, and coherent arbitration decisions with proper formatting, correct grammar, and appropriate citations.
Recognize social context, professional ethics, and social responsibility to build autonomous and responsible capabilities in work.
Possess independent work skills, written communication skills, and the ability to write specialized reports related to research issues.
Understand and apply legal research methodologies, including literature review, theoretical overview, methodological approaches, data collection, analysis, conclusions, and recommendations.
